name: Dear All, The Shopping District and I Are Doing Fine Today
original_name: 拝啓 今日も私と商店街は元気です
overview:
In the fading Poka Poka Jizo Street Shopping District, university student Nakano Sakura is dedicated to revitalizing her family’s bakery and the surrounding community following her grandmother's death. The once-lively area has gone quiet, but Sakura is determined to bring it back to life.

Her breakthrough comes when TV personality Hamano Kenta visits for a filming segment. Thinking on her feet, Sakura snaps a photo with him and uses the design platform Canva to create an eye-catching poster boasting his "seal of approval." Her initiative sparks a chain reaction; inspired neighbors begin designing their own promotional materials, from posters to social media graphics. Through Sakura's creativity and modern tools, the shopkeepers unite to restore the energy and bustle of their beloved shopping street.
